[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (a b: String) : String :=
let len := a.length
have len_eq := a.length = b.length
let result := String.mk len fun i => if a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = b.get (String.Pos.mk i) then '0' else '1'
result
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma get_length_eq (a: String) (i: Nat) (h: i < a.length) :
  a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = a.get (String.Pos.mk i) :=
by
  simp [h]

lemma get_length_eq' (a b: String) (i: Nat) (h: i < a.length ∧ i < b.length) :
  a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = b.get (String.Pos.mk i) →
  a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = a.get (String.Pos.mk i) ∧
  b.get (String.Pos.mk i) = b.get (String.Pos.mk i) :=
by
  simp [h]

lemma get_length_eq'' (a b: String) (i: Nat) (h: i < a.length ∧ i < b.length) :
  a.get (String.Pos.mk i) ≠ b.get (String.Pos.mk i) →
  a.get (String.Pos.mk i) ≠ a.get (String.Pos.mk i) ∧
  b.get (String.Pos.mk i) ≠ b.get (String.Pos.mk i) :=
by
  simp [h]

lemma get_length_eq''' (a b: String) (i: Nat) (h: i < a.length ∧ i < b.length) :
  a.get (String.Pos.mk i) ≠ b.get (String.Pos.mk i) →
  a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = '1' ∧
  b.get (String.Pos.mk i) = '0' ∨
  a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = '0' ∧
  b.get (String.Pos.mk i) = '1' :=
by
  simp [h]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation a b
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_a_all := a.all (fun c => c = '0' ∨ c = '1')
have h_b_all := b.all (fun c => c = '0' ∨ c = '1')
have h_len_eq := a.length = b.length
have h_len_eq' := a.length = result.length
simp [h_len_eq']
have h_result_all := result.all (fun c => c = '0' ∨ c = '1')
simp [h_result_all]
have h_len_eq'' := result.length = b.length
simp [h_len_eq'']
intro i h_i_lt_len
have h_i_pos := String.Pos.mk i
have h_a_get := a.get h_i_pos
have h_b_get := b.get h_i_pos
have h_result_get := result.get h_i_pos
have h_a_eq_b := a.get h_i_pos = b.get h_i_pos
have h_a_neq_b := a.get h_i_pos ≠ b.get h_i_pos
have h_a_eq_b' := get_length_eq a i (by linarith)
have h_a_eq_b'' := get_length_eq' a b i (by linarith)
have h_a_eq_b''' := get_length_eq''' a b i (by linarith)
have h_a_eq_b'''' := get_length_eq'' a b i (by linarith)
by_cases h_a_eq_b
-- case a.get i = b.get i
simp [h_a_eq_b]
have h_result_get_eq_0 := by
  simp [h_result_get, h_a_eq_b']
have h_result_get_eq_0' := by
  simp [h_result_get_eq_0, h_a_eq_b'']
have h_result_get_eq_0'' := by
  simp [h_result_get_eq_0', h_a_eq_b'''']
simp [h_result_get_eq_0'']
-- case a.get i ≠ b.get i
have h_result_get_eq_1 := by
  simp [h_result_get, h_a_eq_b']
have h_result_get_eq_1' := by
  simp [h_result_get_eq_1, h_a_eq_b''']
have h_result_get_eq_1'' := by
  simp [h_result_get_eq_1', h_a_eq_b'''']
simp [h_result_get_eq_1'']
[END]
